title: SKE Crystal 2400 4in1 Blueberry Sour Raspberry Pre-Filled Pods 20mg - 4 x Pods
description: Experience the tantalizing fusion of Blueberry Sour Raspberry in these SKE Crystal 4in1 prefilled pods. The blend of sweet blueberries and tart raspberries with a sour kick offers a vibrant, flavourful vaping experience. The Nic-Salt vape juice in each pod ensures a smooth, satisfying draw and comfortable throat hit. The SKE Crystal 4in1 Vape Pods replicate the popular flavours of SKE Crystal Disposable Vapes in a more cost-effective and eco-friendly format. Designed for the SKE Crystal 4in1 Prefilled Pod Kits, these easy-to-use pods fit seamlessly into the device's rotating mechanism, allowing you to enjoy four flavours in one handy vape kit.
